_note: Items a player can carry (inventory.ts). icon = an emoji shown in the slot. stack = how many fit in one slot. starter = given with the first backpack (in this order). dim = drawn faded (e.g. an empty bottle). badge = a small emoji in the slot's corner.

items.name: Assignment Folder
items.description: Holds the 16 classroom assignments you need to turn in to Mr. Van Diest at the ELD classroom. Every assignment you complete goes in here.

items.name: Stanley Cup 40 oz (empty)
items.description: Your 40 oz Stanley tumbler, empty. Fill it up at a drinking fountain: by the 7th grade LMU classroom, or upstairs next to the ELD classroom (press E at the fountain).

items.name: Stanley Cup 40 oz (full)
items.description: Your 40 oz Stanley tumbler, full of cold water. Drink it any time; refill it at the drinking fountain.

items.name: Pencil Pouch
items.description: A zippered pencil pouch that matches your backpack, from the MPR storage room. Optional objective: find 5 sharpened pencils hidden in the classrooms to fill it. Open your backpack to see its pockets.

items.name: Student Agenda
items.description: Your student agenda planner. Click it to see every objective in detail: what's done and what's left.

items.name: Chromebook
items.description: A school Chromebook borrowed from this classroom's laptop cart. Click it to open it and log in. It stays in this classroom: it goes back to the cart when you leave.

items.name: Community Schools Handout
items.description: "Partners in Learning" from Mr. Martinez, the Community Schools Manager: how schools can leverage families and the community to help multilingual learners. Click it to read it (you can print it or save it as a PDF).

items.name: Burrito
items.description: A warm burrito from the food truck by the MPR, wrapped in foil (from Delma or Raquel). Click it to eat it.

items.name: Vegan Burrito
items.description: The vegan option from the food truck by the MPR: beans, rice, grilled veggies and salsa, no animal products. Click it to eat it.
